formal_statement:
theorem OAI.PiExponent.LiteralAnalytic.tendsto_analyticRemainder {nu : ℝ} (d : FixedData nu) :
    Tendsto (analyticRemainder d) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  sorry
natural_language_statement: For every real $\nu$ and original fixed admissible datum $d$, the exact source remainder $R_d(H)$ tends to zero as $H\to+\infty$: $\operatorname{Tendsto}(R_d,\operatorname{atTop},\mathcal N(0))$.
